query:
-- Check how many orderProducts have unitPrice = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) as zero_price_count FROM orderProducts WHERE unitPrice = 0 OR unitPrice IS NULL;

-- Check 26EGB0344 products specifically
SELECT op.id, op.productName, op.sku, op.quantity, op.unitPrice, o.orderNumber, o.orderAmount
FROM orderProducts op
JOIN orders o ON op.orderId = o.id
WHERE o.orderNumber = '26EGB0344';
